name: megalinter
description: Set up, run and fix MegaLinter on any repository: 100+ linters for 69+ languages, 23+ formats and 21+ tooling formats, from CI or locally.

interface.shortDescription: Lint, fix and secure any repository with 100+ linters.
interface.longDescription: MegaLinter aggregates 100+ linters covering 69+ languages, 23+ formats and 21+ tooling formats. This plugin installs it on your repository, collects errors from a CI job or a local Docker run, and fixes them using per-linter fix guides.
interface.defaultPrompt: Set up MegaLinter on this repository and fix the errors it reports
capabilities: Collect lint errors from a CI job or a local run
Fix lint errors with per-linter fix guides
